name: CeraVe Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum 30ml | Brightening, Anti-Aging & Hydrating
description:
CeraVe Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum is a lightweight, antioxidant-rich formula designed to brighten skin, reduce dark spots, and smooth fine lines. Enriched with 10% pure Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid), Hyaluronic Acid, Ceramides, and Vitamin B5, it hydrates, strengthens the skin barrier, and restores a healthy, radiant complexion. Fragrance-free and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, it protects skin while improving texture and tone.
Key Features
 Contains 10% pure Vitamin C for brightening and antioxidant protection
 Reduces dark spots, dullness, and fine lines
 Hydrates and restores skin barrier with Ceramides and Hyaluronic Acid
 Vitamin B5 nourishes and supports healthy skin
 Lightweight, fragrance-free, suitable for sensitive skin
 30ml pack with protective packaging to maintain formula potency
How to Use
 Apply a few drops onto clean, dry face
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use morning and night for best results
 Follow with moisturizer or sunscreen during daytime
Material
Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid), Ceramides, Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B5, serum base
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 30ml CeraVe Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum
